description: This file defines a custom transition class ChangeColor for Android animations, which animates background color changes between scenes.

classes.name: ChangeColor
classes.description: A custom Transition subclass for animating background color changes between scenes.

methods.name: captureValues
methods.description: Adds the background drawable property of a view to the transition values map for later animation.

methods.name: captureStartValues
methods.description: Captures the initial background drawable of the target view.

methods.name: captureEndValues
methods.description: Captures the final background drawable of the target view.

methods.name: createAnimator
methods.description: Creates an animator that transitions the background color from start to end if they are ColorDrawables.
